mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN pay_time >= #{dayStart} AND pay_time < #{dayEnd} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS todayPaidOrderCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN pay_time >= #{dayStart} AND pay_time < #{dayEnd} THEN paid_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS todayPaidAmount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN order_status = 'PENDING_SHIPMENT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pendingShipmentCount, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM mall_member WHERE create_time >= #{dayStart} AND create_time < #{dayEnd}) AS todayNewMemberCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN order_status = 'PENDING_PAYMENT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pendingPaymentCount, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM mall_product_sku WHERE del_flag = '0' AND status = '0' AND available_stock <= warning_stock) AS lowStockSkuCount FROM mall_order WHERE order_status IN ('PENDING_SHIPMENT', 'SHIPPED', 'COMPLETED', 'PENDING_PAYMENT')

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(pay_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS day, COALESCE(SUM(paid_amount), 0) AS paidAmount, COUNT(1) AS paidOrderCount FROM mall_order WHERE pay_time >= #{start} AND pay_time < #{end} AND order_status IN ('PENDING_SHIPMENT', 'SHIPPED', 'COMPLETED') GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(pay_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY day ASC

SELECT i.sku_id AS skuId, MAX(i.product_name_snapshot) AS productName, MAX(i.sku_name_snapshot) AS skuName, COALESCE(SUM(i.quantity), 0) AS salesQuantity, COALESCE(SUM(i.payable_amount), 0) AS paidAmount FROM mall_order_item i INNER JOIN mall_order o ON o.order_id = i.order_id WHERE o.pay_time >= #{start} AND o.pay_time < #{end} AND o.order_status IN ('PENDING_SHIPMENT', 'SHIPPED', 'COMPLETED') GROUP BY i.sku_id ORDER BY salesQuantity DESC, paidAmount DESC LIMIT 10
